description: Capture a public web page as a PNG, JPEG or WEBP image: any viewport size, full page, retina scaling, optional cookie-banner hiding. Free tier only (credits do not apply to this tool). Output: a file (image/png | image/jpeg | image/webp) returned inline, at most 1 MiB. The screenshot

delay_ms.description: Extra wait after load, before the shot

full_page.description: Capture the whole scrollable page (capped at 16384 CSS px / 50 megapixels)

url.description: Public http(s) URL (robots.txt is honoured), or an inline data:text/html URL

name: screenshot
title: Website screenshot
